{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data
# We must drop QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

df_clean = df[~qa_mask]

# Confirm
assert len(df_clean) == 894, f'Expected 894, got {len(df_clean)}'

# Now compute conversion rate by segment
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total orders) in each segment
conversion_by_segment = df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
conversion_by_segment['rate'] = conversion_by_segment['sum'] / conversion_by_segment['count']

# Sort by rate descending
conversion_by_segment = conversion_by_segment.sort_values('rate', ascending=False)

# Display results
conversion_by_segment"}
